Game Overview

Cat and Rabbit Holiday is a animal title where join the adorable Cat and Rabbit as they embark on a whimsical winter holiday. Dive into an enchanting dress-up adventure, matching cozy outfits and charming accessories, all with intuitive controls. Unleash your creativity and create heartwarming styles for this delightful duo against a snowy backdrop.
